description:
You are the Data Manager for the Bo District Malaria Reduction Pilot. You need to configure DHIS2 for a comparative cohort analysis.

Login to DHIS2 (admin/district) and perform the following:

1. Create two new Organisation Unit Groups:
   - Name: 'Malaria Pilot Sites' (Add any 3 facilities from Bo District)
   - Name: 'Malaria Control Sites' (Add 3 different facilities from Bo District)

2. Create an Organisation Unit Group Set:
   - Name: 'Malaria Pilot Status'
   - Include both the Pilot and Control groups you just created.

3. Update the Analytics Tables (via Data Administration app) to ensure these new groups are available for analysis.

4. Create a Column Chart in the Data Visualizer app:
   - Title: 'Pilot vs Control Malaria 2023'
   - Data: 'Malaria RDT Positive' (or 'Malaria RDT positive cases')
   - Series/Dimension: Use your new 'Malaria Pilot Status' group set.
   - Period: 2023
   - Filter: Bo District
   - Save the visualization.
